errors.evidence: Description assigns 21% to 体育 (blue), but the figure shows 体育 as 4%. 21% corresponds to 科学 (dark blue).
Description assigns 榜样 to red, but the figure shows 榜样 as bright yellow. The color red is not used in the figure.
Description assigns 经济 to cyan and 4%, but the figure shows 经济 as pink and 2%. 4% corresponds to 体育 (blue).
Description assigns 科学 to purple and 2%, but the figure shows 科学 as dark blue and 21%. Purple is not used in the figure.
Description states there are nine slices, but the figure shows eight slices.
The description does not mention the dominant categories ('科学', '社会', and '榜样') or minor categories ('文化', '政治').
The description incorrectly states the legend is in the top-right corner, but the figure shows it at the bottom.
The description incorrectly implies a left-to-right ordering of slices, but pie charts do not have such an ordering. No atom supports this claim.
The description mentions a purple slice, but no such color exists in the figure.
The description does not mention the chart's purpose: distribution of AI-generated children's long news by topic.
